body.title: Implement SQL aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX)
body.body: ## Issues Fixed Fixes # (#126) # Implement SQL Aggregate Functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX) ## Summary Added support for standard SQL aggregate functions: `COUNT`, `SUM`, `AVG`, `MIN`, `MAX`. ## Description This PR implements aggregation logic in the query executor and updates the SQL parser to support aggregate functions in `SELECT` statements. ### Changes - **Core Types**: Added `AggregateType` enum and updated `SelectItem` to support aggregation. - **SQL Parser**: Updated parser to recognize aggregate functions (e.g., `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table`). - **Query Executor**: Implemented logic to scan filtered rows and compute aggregate results. - **Tests**: Added integration tests in [test…
